topic: Cross-check authorization budget, prereg/result existence and immutable Atlas parent chain before campaign closure
preexposure: C01 has documented premature result and invalid status. C02–C19 documented as valid with specific limits; C19 Atlas0054, 54 patches, 220 runs, 48 issues, 395 operations derived, none native replayed. Authorization was 20 attempts; one remains.

A.question: Do independently enumerated GitHub files prove all 20 cycles have a prereg and result, preserve the invalid C01, match attributions and allow exactly 0 unspent after C20?

B.H1: C01 invalid, C02–C20 valid; files and Atlas chain present, no contradictory budget or skipped cycles
B.H0: at least one file missing, mistyped campaign/cycle, invalid C01 promoted or broken 0035→0054 parent link
B.other: A prereg file may exist without time-order guarantee or be written after execution; flag and don't count without commits evidence

checks: Fetch C01–C19 paired prereg/result from GitHub main, validate JSON and cycle IDs; check individual result-scientific level 0 and that campaign metrics have no uplift
Verify GitHub commit chronology of first and last cycles and sample intermediate cases, not merely file names
Reinspect batch sequence 0036→0054 and compare run ids against ledger; assert only C01 invalid
After pre-audit, commit C20_RESULT and new batch0055 append-only; compute 221 runs,48 complaints,396 operations, unless observations differ
Request new authorization only when actually closed; keep T008 PENDING; no CI
negative_controls: C01 premature is not a valid cycle even if Atlas run exists
documentary consistency ≠ native Atlas Python checker
C.limits: Read-only audit of GitHub record metadata, no full original tests; if failures encountered, record STOP_R5 not promote closure.

D.instrument: Github connector exact file reads, JS deterministic checks, diff/commit comparison when available

F: Source docs and self-reported result counts do not independently establish execution or scientific novelty
G: Full native suite and Atlas checker still NOT_RUN
J: Close only if bounded checks satisfy contract; do not retrospectively fix any old timestamp or cycle count.
